description: A contemporary cafe dining space photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a banquette seating run along the right wall in a three-quarter corner composition that shows both the wall and the row of tables. The plaster walls are finished in a warm greige limewash with a smooth, slightly uneven texture. The lower third of the wall is paneled in light natural wood wainscoting. A continuous banquette runs the length of the scene, upholstered in cognac-tan smooth faux leather with softly rounded backs. Paired with it, individual square blonde wood dining tables sit on black steel pedestal bases, each set with a small glass bud vase holding dried pink flowers and a cardboard tissue box holder. Lightweight dining chairs in warm grey upholstered seats with dark bronze wire frames pull up to each table. Tall black-framed floor-to-ceiling windows on the left wall flood the space with natural daylight, revealing a busy street scene outside. Along the upper plaster wall above the banquette, three matte black wall-mounted arm units each aim a tight directed beam of warm amber light downward onto the table zones, their warm pools of illumination punctuating the plaster surface at regular intervals. The atmosphere is calm, designed, and café-modern.
